name: APK Derle

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Depoyu indir
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Node.js kur
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Java kur
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21

      - name: Android SDK kur
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - name: NPM bagimliliklarini yukle
        run: npm install

      - name: Android platformunu ekle
        run: npx cap add android

      - name: Uygulama ikonunu olustur
        run: npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#0f2745' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#0f2745'

      - name: Unity Ads koprusunu (MainActivity) uygula
        run: |
          cp patches/MainActivity.java android/app/src/main/java/com/yapayzekapolat1/bankakur/MainActivity.java

      - name: Unity Ads bagimliligini build.gradle'a ekle
        run: |
          sed -i "/dependencies {/a\\    implementation 'com.unity3d.ads:unity-ads:4.+'" android/app/build.gradle

      - name: Web dosyalarini Android projesine kopyala
        run: npx cap sync android

      - name: Gradle wrapper izinlerini ayarla
        run: chmod +x android/gradlew

      - name: Debug APK derle
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew assembleDebug --stacktrace

      - name: APK'yi Actions ciktisi olarak yukle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ioz-bank-tycoon-debug-apk
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
